samples.title: Teaching Assistant at Medway Middle School

reads.need: The work posted in town is schools, care and shops
reads.evidence: 65 postings in 30 days. The largest family is office and admin at 12, and the one we opened was a teaching assistant at Medway Middle School. Engineering is 1 and software is 0, in a town where 62.4% of adults hold a bachelor's degree.
reads.quality: The jobs posted in town are the ones that keep it running: classrooms, childcare, the pharmacy, the grocery store. Most residents with degrees look to be working somewhere else.
reads.move: Ask the schools and the childcare centers how long these roles stay open. If they sit unfilled, that is the first need to write down.
reads.why: 65 is a small count, the feed cannot tell Medway, Massachusetts from other towns called Medway, and no one in Medway has read this.

reads.need: A town of owners with a long trip to work
reads.evidence: 85.9% of homes are owned by the people living in them and the mean commute is 30.4 minutes. Median household income is $173,750. The population is up 5.3% since 2020.
reads.quality: People settle here and travel out to work. With so few homes to rent, the people who staff the schools, shops and care work may have to live somewhere else.
reads.move: Find out where the people who work in Medway live, using the Census commuting files.
reads.why: Survey averages. We have no wages for the postings and no commuting data yet.
